title: Two-outlet brief: invents a disagreement
story: Same sources, but the writer skips the check and adds a third disagreement about the mayor that neither article contains. Grounding and verification catch it.
content_note: Intentional negative example: the brief invents a disagreement neither outlet printed. Fully fictional.
description: A desk editor sends two articles about one council vote to two reader agents in parallel, then a brief writer joins their claim lists into a short brief of where the outlets disagree. Rule: add no disagreement that was in neither.
